The deterministic audit and free-form Scion Agent path completed, while desktop and phone workspaces retained zero document overflow.
A completed ready receipt removes the redundant Finish package starter and changes the Agent greeting to ready-state language.
ZIP assembly exposes Preparing ZIP feedback, and the physical 88,136-byte archive passes integrity with the same embedded grade.
The Always included badge declares a legible explicit dark treatment under the global dark-surface remap.
The burden receipt binds the upstream source-compiler receipt and all twelve replay projects, and the normal test suite verifies the chain.
No adapter or Gemma weight changes; the release improves browser UX, orchestration, export feedback, and evidence integrity.
